title: Reading lab: Philippians 2:5–11
subtitle: Read exhortation, description, and response across a dense unit.
overview: Philippians 2:5–11 moves from an imperative-like appeal into a concentrated description and then to a universal response. Mark the shift before handling individual forms.
This passage requires restraint: parse its participles and clauses accurately before using the text to settle larger theological debates.

items.grc: τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
items.en: Have this mind among yourselves, which was also in Christ Jesus.

items.grc: διὸ καὶ ὁ θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα.
items.en: Therefore God also highly exalted him and graciously gave him the name above every name.
